observation.command:
source /opt/mapserver/env.sh
cd /opt/mapserver
# Try to get capabilities from the mapserv CGI directly by feeding a request
# First verify the mapfile loads with env vars
timeout 20 env MS_MAP_FILE=/opt/mapserver/mapserver.map shp2img -e 2>&1 | head -5
echo "exit=$?"
echo "=== try GetCapabilities via CGI (simulated) ==="
# mapserv needs QUERY_STRING + env. Let's build a small test.
export QUERY_STRING="request=GetCapabilities&service=WMS&version=1.1.1"
export REQUEST_METHOD="GET"
export SERVER_PROTOCOL="HTTP/1.1"
export HTTP_HOST="localhost:8080"
timeout 20 mapserv 2>/dev/null | head -c 400
echo
echo "exit=$?"
